description: September 10 birthday meaning: Virgo decan 2, birthday number 1, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a September 10 birthday falls in Virgo, in the second decan, with Mercury as the sign's ruler and Saturn as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 1. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Virgo is mutable and earth.

sections.heading: Personality of a September 10 birthday
paragraphs: Ten reduces to 1 in numerology, and the 10th of September often wears that number's independence lightly but firmly. Seventeen degrees of Virgo, in the decan that Saturn sub-rules, adds self-discipline and a preference for letting good work speak for itself. This is a birthday associated with quiet self-starters who set their own standards, then hold themselves to them more strictly than anyone else would.

By noon UTC on September 10, the Sun has normally reached roughly 17° of Virgo. That places the date in the Virgo decan that astrologers give to Saturn, the second of three. From 10 to 19 degrees of Virgo the sub-ruler is Saturn, which also rules Capricorn. Early-to-mid September birthdays therefore combine Virgo's attention to detail with a serious, long-term sense of responsibility. These natives are frequently described as dependable, disciplined and drawn to work that matters over years rather than weeks. They may carry duties others have dropped, without complaining about it. Saturn can also bring self-doubt and a reluctance to celebrate small wins. Allowing progress to count before it is complete often helps this decan enjoy the sturdy structures it is so good at building.

sections.heading: Numerology of the September 10 birthday
paragraphs: A birthday on the 10th is a compound: 1 + 0 = 1. In Pythagorean numerology this is read as a 1 with a 0 attached, and the 0 is often described as amplifying whatever stands beside it. So the 10th carries the independence and initiative of the 1, with an added sense of potential and of cycles completing and restarting. People born on this day are frequently portrayed as self-reliant and adaptable, able to begin again after setbacks. The day number is secondary to the Life Path, but here it often shows as a quiet, practical resilience.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same September 10 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 1 for 1980, 11 for 1990, 3 for 2000 and 4 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: September 10 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: A September birthday arrives at the turn into autumn for the northern hemisphere, a season of new terms and gathering in, and at the start of spring in the southern. Virgo occupies most of the month, with Libra taking over around September 22 or 23, near the equinox. September is month 9 in numerology, the number of completion, compassion and a broad, humanitarian outlook. September 10 is the 253rd day of the year (254th in a leap year). In most years Libra season is under way by September 23, 13 days after this birthday.

Chinese astrology is straightforward for a September 10 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies. September 10 is also the birthday of Jack Ma (1964), Arthur Holly Compton (1892) and Colin Firth (1960).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is September 10?
faq.answer: September 10 is Virgo in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Virgo, which tradition links with Saturn.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on September 10?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On September 10 the Life Path is 8 in 1960, 9 in 1970, 1 in 1980, 11 in 1990, 3 in 2000, 4 in 2010 and 5 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 1 for everyone born on the 10th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on September 10?
faq.answer: By September 10 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on September 10?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with a September 10 birthday are Jack Ma (1964), Arthur Holly Compton (1892) and Colin Firth (1960). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
